title: A Veil for the Garden
author: Sable Ashgrove
blurb: Sable Brightwater, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
